heading: Definitions

tree.heading: Eligible entity
tree.text: The term “eligible entity” means any of the following entities:

children.text: An industrial entity or a multi-institutional consortium thereof.

tree.heading: Institution of higher education
tree.text: The term “institution of higher education” means—

children.text: an institution of higher education (as defined in section 1001(a) of title 20); or
a postsecondary vocational institution (as defined in section 1002(c) of title 20).

tree.heading: Marine energy
tree.text: The term “marine energy” means energy from—

children.text: waves, tides, and currents in oceans, estuaries, and tidal areas;
free flowing water in rivers, lakes, streams, and man-made channels;
differentials in salinity and pressure gradients; and
differentials in water temperature, including ocean thermal energy conversion.

tree.heading: National laboratory
tree.text: The term “National Laboratory” has the meaning given such term in section 15801(3) of this title.

tree.heading: Water power
tree.text: The term “water power” refers to hydropower, including conduit power, pumped storage, and marine energy technologies.

tree.heading: Microgrid
tree.text: The term “microgrid” has the meaning given such term in section 17231 of this title.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 17211, Pub. L. 110–140, title VI, § 632, Dec. 19, 2007, 121 Stat. 1686, related to definitions of terms, prior to the general amendment of this part by Pub. L. 116–260.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: This part was formerly known as the “Marine and Hydrokinetic Renewable Energy Research and Development Act”, see Short Title note formerly set out under section 17001 of this title.
